{"claims": [
  {"text": "Johnson & Johnson delivered a solid performance in its most recent fiscal year, FY2024, with revenue climbing to roughly $98.2 billion", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "revenue", "period": "FY2024", "period_end": null, "value": 98200000000, "unit": "USD", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "a modest 3% increase over FY2023’s $95.5 billion", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "revenue_growth_yoy", "period": "FY2024", "period_end": null, "value": 0.03, "unit": "ratio", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "FY2023’s $95.5 billion", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "revenue", "period": "FY2023", "period_end": null, "value": 95500000000, "unit": "USD", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "Net income rose to about $15.5 billion, up from $14.8 billion in FY2023", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "net_income", "period": "FY2024", "period_end": null, "value": 15500000000, "unit": "USD", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "up from $14.8 billion in FY2023", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "net_income", "period": "FY2023", "period_end": null, "value": 14800000000, "unit": "USD", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "diluted earnings per share reached $7.55 versus $7.30 the prior year", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "eps_diluted", "period": "FY2024", "period_end": null, "value": 7.55, "unit": "USD/share", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "$7.30 the prior year", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "eps_diluted", "period": "FY2023", "period_end": null, "value": 7.30, "unit": "USD/share", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "Operating cash flow remained robust at roughly $20.1 billion", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "operating_cash_flow", "period": "FY2024", "period_end": null, "value": 20100000000, "unit": "USD", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "Gross margins held steady around 55%", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "gross_margin", "period": "FY2024", "period_end": null, "value": 0.55, "unit": "ratio", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "operating margins improved slightly to 16.2% from 15.8% in FY2023", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "operating_margin", "period": "FY2024", "period_end": null, "value": 0.162, "unit": "ratio", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "15.8% in FY2023", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "operating_margin", "period": "FY2023", "period_end": null, "value": 0.158, "unit": "ratio", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "In FY2022, JNJ reported revenue of $93.5 billion", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "revenue", "period": "FY2022", "period_end": null, "value": 93500000000, "unit": "USD", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "net income of $13.9 billion", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "net_income", "period": "FY2022", "period_end": null, "value": 13900000000, "unit": "USD", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "EPS of $6.90", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "eps_diluted", "period": "FY2022", "period_end": null, "value": 6.90, "unit": "USD/share", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "operating cash flow of $18.7 billion", "type": "fundamental", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": "operating_cash_flow", "period": "FY2022", "period_end": null, "value": 18700000000, "unit": "USD", "key": false, "main_reason": false},
  {"text": "The stock trades at a forward P/E near 15×", "type": "sentiment", "ticker": "JNJ", "metric": null, "period": null, "period_end": null, "value": 15, "unit": "ratio", "key": false, "main_reason": false}
